classes.name: Scan findings
classes.handling: Evidence and rankings about what runs on the user's machine. Stays local; emitted to the terminal and optional --json.

classes.name: Quarantine manifest
classes.handling: Record of what was disabled and moved, with original paths. The undo record and RCA trail; stored under ~/CounterSpyQuarantine.

classes.name: Process list
classes.handling: ps/lsof output — running processes, ancestry, argv, and sockets. Read-only, in-memory.

classes.name: Code signatures
classes.handling: codesign/spctl output — signing authority and Gatekeeper verdict. Read-only, in-memory.

classes.name: TCC privacy grants
classes.handling: Which apps hold Accessibility / Input Monitoring / Screen Recording / Full Disk Access. Read from the TCC databases (requires sudo).

classes.name: Captured flow payload
classes.handling: Raw bytes read from /dev/bpf for a single user-selected flow. Ephemeral (in-memory, for the inspection view only; never written to disk unless the user runs an explicit export). Never leaves the machine. TLS ciphertext is not surfaced; readable plaintext is shown with secrets masked until reveal (§6). Least-privilege: the BPF filter is scoped to the one flow, not the interface.

classes.name: Local triage decisions
classes.handling: A user's local 'reviewed / leave it' acks: subject key + a fingerprint of the finding's state + timestamp. Local-only — never transmitted; affects the Findings display (flag/recede) only. Stored under ~/.config/counterspy/ack.json.
